title: Receive XRP
description: Learn how to receive XRP in XRP Mobile: open Receive, pick XRP, and share your deposit address or QR code. We also cover the XRP Ledger network warning and the 1 XRP minimum that activates a new account.
lede: Need your XRP deposit address? Here's the safe way to find it, in seconds.

steps.caption: Open XRP Mobile
steps.body: First, open XRP Mobile. For this demo we create a brand new wallet. If you already have one, you'll start from the home screen.

steps.caption: Quick setup
steps.body: Name it, back up the recovery phrase and set a PIN. The wallet is ready in seconds.

steps.caption: Open your wallet
steps.body: Open your wallet, skip the notifications prompt for now, and you land on home.

steps.caption: Tap Receive
steps.body: Now tap Receive. XRP Mobile asks which asset you want to receive.

steps.caption: Search your asset
steps.body: Type to search. Type xrp and the list narrows to exactly what we need.

steps.caption: Your deposit address
steps.body: And here it is: your QR code and deposit address. Only send XRP over the XRP Ledger network, and mind the 1 XRP minimum that activates a new account. Tap the copy icon and share it safely.
